verdict.rationale: Adyen exposes event-driven webhooks that can push status changes (e.g., account, payout, chargeback events) to a user-defined endpoint, and lets platforms configure custom risk/monitoring rules, which together enable event-triggered automation. However, this requires building your own listener/logic outside Adyen rather than a built-in no-code rules engine for arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: a native rule-builder/automation engine, examples of 'if event X then action Y' automation, and evidence of AI-native rule definition beyond webhooks and risk-rule configuration.
